// diagnostic

E1802

The REPL interpreter can't run `{feature}`.

What

The REPL interpreter can't run `{feature}`.

Why

The REPL is an interpreter for learning Jet; some features — FFI, tasks/channels, `#Unsafe`, and OS-level APIs — require the real compiler.

Fix

Run `jet run <file.jet>` or `jet build <file.jet>` to use the full compiler.
